markets.rules_primary: If Austin Bashi  wins the Austin Bashi vs Lucas Brennan professional MMA fight originally scheduled for Nov 6, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If the fight ends in a draw/no contest, both markets will resolve to $0.50. Note that any revisions after Expiration will not be considered. If the fight is cancelled or not started within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start, both markets will resolve to a fair price.
